Title: Show HN: Pizza Bot – An inbox for AI agents that work in the background
Description:
Hi HN - long-time lurker (since 2012!), first time poster.

Pizza Bot is a self-hosted desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux that runs AI agents in the background and exposes them through an email-like UI. Finished work shows up in Unread, and anything waiting on your approval shows up in Action.
